batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b YS Chahal

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c Mandeep Singh b D Wiese

batting.name: RN ten Doeschate
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b MA Starc

batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c AD Russell b GB Hogg

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b AD Russell

balls.text: cut hard towards backward point where a fumble from Gayle allows the single. That's the end of the innings, it's been a whirlwind
a full ball is slightly down leg side, that was so close to leg stump as Yusuf moved across his crease to glance, wide enough to be called though

a full toss and Yadav misses the paddle right in front of the stumps, Starc appeals for lbw but it's given not out, I'm not sure why, that looked close, especially since the umpire said there was no bat on it
carved towards third man for a single

Yusuf top edges a full toss and is caught by Kohli running in from long on, it's been called a no-ball though and Kohli isn't happy about the call. It's a tight call, Yusuf was well forward and it wasn't above his waist.

a full and straight delivery, the batsman moves across to flick and gets an inside edge on to the pad, there's an appeal for lbw. The batsmen run and Starc races to the ball, collects and hits the stumps at the striker's end, the batsman is just safe
slants down leg and gets glanced towards fine leg for a single

a good length ball, on a straight line, ten Doeschate plays a lofted flick but sort of checks his shot, he ends up chipping the ball high in the air and the fielder moving back to get under the batch is AB de Villiers, he takes it easily

hammered flat and powerfully, and just high enough to clear the leaping fielder at long on. It was a short of a length ball and Yusuf just slogged it off the front foot, smashing it from outside off stump
Yusuf slogged wildly outside off but was hopelessly beaten

what a strike by Karthik, he's run out Russell! Ten Doeschate pulled but was beaten by another slower ball, Russell tried to get on strike by stealing a bye but Karthik was too sharp for him. He collected cleanly and threw quickly, the direct hit catching the sprinting Russell inches short. A huge lift for RCB with eight balls to go
fuller and faster outside off stump, ten Doeschate slices the ball through backward point with a square drive, superbly timed
a slower ball on a good length around off stump, ten Doeschate pulled a day too early and missed
it's ten Doeschate this time! He takes a step towards the off side, gets outside the line of off stump, picks up a slower ball and heaves it over the square leg boundary
full ball outside off and it's disappeared for six! Russell cleared his front foot, got under the delivery and slammed it back over the bowler's head
mighty mow from Russell but he was beaten by the slower one angling across him from round the wicket, the length was on the shorter side and Russell swung way too early
length ball just outside off, ten Doeschate drives from his crease through cover
swings powerfully across the line but gets an inside edge towards square leg

goes round the stumps to cramp Russell for room but it does not work, he moves his front foot out of the way and drills a low full toss fiercely towards long-on, it wasn't far away from the fielder but he had no chance
good length on off and middle, nudged off the pads into the leg side for a single
goes deep into his crease and dabs the ball through wicket, they race through for two because the fielders have some ground to cover to get to the ball

Uthappa tries to smash it like Russell, getting down low and slogging across the line. The ball hits the top edge though and goes really high in the air, when it lands between square leg and midwicket, it falls into Karthik's gloves. He called for it early and judged the catch well
driven on the back foot towards wide long off for a single
the legbreak this time, wide outside off, Russell goes back and cuts, really hard. No one moves as the ball speeds to the boundary
Russell gets down on one knee, winds up and then unleashes a fearsome slog, smashing the googly flat and into the gap on the midwicket boundary
Uthappa moves outside leg an cuts the ball from around leg stump towards point

makes contact this time! Russell moves his front leg towards the leg side to create hitting space and then lofts a length ball over the bowler's head, just about clears the boundary so he can't have timed it ll that well
clears his front foot again and aims to heave for a six over midwicket, but the ball flies off the outside edge and races past the keeper to the third man boundary
another slower ball, Russell clears his front foot and swings with tremendous power, he doesn't connect and is beaten very close to off stump
the slower ball wide outside off stump, Russell doesn't get near it this time, swung rather wildly he did
no one on the field is getting near that! Russell pulls the short ball so hard that it might break, that's in the stands at deep midwicket
Uthappa pulls a short ball towards wide long on where Kohli covers good ground to his right to get to the catch but then spills it as he is unbalanced and on the move, should have held that
width outside off and Russell cuts so hard that the camera struggles to keep up with the ball as it races across a damp outfield to the point boundary
leaps out of his crease and then Uthappa has to reach out for a wide leg break and hit it over the bowler's head. He mis-timed that
that's the googly on off and middle stump, Russell stays in his crease and plays the ball awkwardly towards square leg
played towards point for a single
Uthappa makes room and slaps the ball with a flat bat to long off for a single, Chahal is sloppy in collecting AB's clean throw and concedes an overthrow
flatter and straight from the legspinner, Russell tries to pull but mis-times it through midwicket
driven into the covers for a single

caught one-handed near his head at point! Mandeep has plucked it out of the air! Gambhir got down low and scooped a full ball flat and hard towards point, Mandeep jumped up with his right hand at head height and caught it cleanly. I think Mandeep thought it was going higher than it did and ended up having to adjust, he could have taken it with both hands
Gambhir tries to repeat the shot but this time he is beaten by a slower ball outside off stump
Gambhir clears his front leg and mows the ball powerfully to the deep midwicket boundary

Karthik dives sharply to his left to save a boundary, Uthappa had swung hard at a good length ball  and got a bottom edge into the ground and towards the keeper. The batsmen steal a run, and Karthik's throw at the non-striker's end misses
Weise sprays his first ball wide outside off, Gambhir lunges towards it and slices, lofting the ball through point. The fielding restrictions are over so there are fielders in the deep
a length delivery outside off, Uthappa stays balanced on the front foot as he plays the lofted drive over cover and towards the vacant boundary
another short ball marginally down leg also beats Uthappa's pull, did he get a touch on that? Umpire does not call it wide
the slower short ball, rolled his wrists over it, Uthappa was on the front foot and pulled too early
Uthappa takes two nimble steps down the pitch and drives the ball hard to cover, he converted it into a full length, but couldn't find the placement
good length on middle and off, steered towards point and they run a quick single again
short of a length and the line is down leg side, another wide
huge appeal from Harshal Patel as a full ball slants into Uthappa and hits the pad as the batsman moves forward to play on the leg side, impact might have been outside off
Uthappa tries to cut a good length ball that's too close to off and gets a bottom edge past his stumps, they run a  quick single before the keeper can get to the ball
short ball, Uthappa aims for the hook but gets a top edge that flies towards third man, Harshal Patel runs across to field but doesn't dive, the ball hits the rope
a full ball and Uthappa has given Weise no chance to mis-field this time, hammering the drive past him at mid-off for four
good length around off stump, punched off the front foot to cover
Uthappa drives on the front foot to mid-off where Weise dives over the ball and lets it go through for runs, mid-on gives chase
short of a length on leg and middle, Gambhir goes back in his crease, gets on top of the bounce and dabs the ball towards square for a single
full delivery outside off stump, Uthappa strides forward and drives into the covers, AB fields and throws at the bowler's end. Gambhir was safe this time, but the ball did not hit
Gambhir steers a length ball towards third man for a single
Gambhir's straight drive is too far away from Starc's boot, he pressed forward and punched that on the up, hitting through the line past the bowler. Despite all the rain the outfield is still quick
that's a huge wide down leg side, Starc hasn't adjusted his line for the left-hander
shot! And well stopped by Starc! Uthappa pushed forward and drove a full ball dead straight, had Starc not stopped in his follow through and stuck his boot out, that would have been four
strays down leg side this time, first run to KKR

good length around off stump, Uthappa pushes into the covers on the front foot, Gambhir wants the strike but gets sent back, Kohli fields at cover and throws at the bowler's end, Gambhir would have been out with a direct hit
short of a length on a great line from Starc, accurate delivery right away, Uthappa sways out of the line as it slants across him, dropping his wrists

Mandeep has done it, Russell has been KKR's best player on the night but he wasn't able to defend 12 in the final over. Mandeep seals the game with two balls to spare with a withering pull, smashing the shorter ball over the backward square leg boundary. The Chinnaswamy erupts in a burst of noise.
a sensational strike from Mandeep! He makes room outside leg to get under a full ball and flays at it, slicing the ball while down on one leg, carving it over the backward point boudnary
short of a length and straight, the batsman charges and swings, hitting it through midwicket, they race back for the second
in the blockhole again, good ball, played to long on for a single
edged and another boundary, to third man! Mandeep simply made room to hit on the off side and swung hard, the ball flew off the outside edge and raced away

fine leg is in the circle and Mandeep sends the ball high over that fielder with a scoop, the ball bounces off the practices pitches and goes over the boundary as Cummins comes racing in from long leg and dives desperately
good length around off stump, the batsman tries to pull but mis-times it past the bowler
another blockhole delivery on middle stump, superb stuff from Yadav, the batsman tries to make room and then has to hurry to dig it out on the off side
in the blockhole, Mandeep can only dig it out to long on for a single

a full ball outside off and Weise drills the ball hard towards wide long off with a fluent drive, Suryakumar sprints to his left and dives to save the boundary. He gets on his feet quickly and releases the ball swiftly too, top fielding
another one in the blockhole, dug out down the ground for one, Russell has done a superb job in his first over

in the blockhole, pinpoint accuracy from Russell, but the batsman manages to dig it out and because there is no infielder at midwicket they manage to run two as the fielder has to run in from the deep
short of a length just outside off, Mandeep pulls the ball and hits it through midwicket, but he too did not time that well
a good length ball outside off, slogs across the line and hits it through midwicket, not timed well either
a bouncer, but the umpire says it is too high, a wide called
Russell can do anything! He's got Kohli now. It was just short of a length and hurried Kohli a bit, he mis-timed the loft straight to the fielder at long-on ...
nearly in the blockhole, an accurate start, played of the pads through square leg
Kohli finishes the over perfectly by lofting a full ball clean over long on for six, the game has swung again, RCB steaming towards the target.
steps out of his crease but is not to the pitch of the ball, he adjusts and hits the ball in front of point
waits in his crease for a flatter and shorter ball and pull so hard into the gap on the midwicket boundary, just beats the diving fielder
hit flat and hard towards long on where Russell comes racing in from the line and dives forward desperately, top effort but the ball drops just short
lofts of room for Mandeep as the legbreak spins away from him as he moves towards leg to loft inside out into the gap on the cover coundary
Kohli makes room, steps out and then hits the ball along the ground to long off
he's hit this one all right, slogging across the line and smacking the ball flat over the square leg boundary
Mandeep has no clue as the ball spins sharply away from him, big-spinning googly that was, Mandeep wafted at it and was beaten
quicker ball, Kohli is cramped for room by the line and has to hurry the hit through midwicket
that was the one that spins into the right-hander, Mandeep mis-times the hit past the bowler, just the single
tossed up outside off, driven to long off for a single
good length outside off from Hogg, hits it off the back foot through cover
pulled through midwicket for a single
Madeep stays in his crease and plays the legbreak towards cover

he's bowled him! A quicker ball outside off stump, a bit on the shorter side but AB's attempt at cutting it ended up in a bottom edge on to his stumps. KKR are right back in this after a hammering early on. That was really quick from Chawla
Chawla slides the googly into Kohli and he goes back to pull to deep square leg
dragged too short and AB drives hard off the back foot, the fielder at cover can't make a clean stop
AB steps out of his crease and defends towards the bowler, was not to the pitch of the ball
worked off the pads through square leg for a single

Gayle slogs the ball hard and flat towards long-on, the fielder rushing to his right to get behind the catch is Russell and he makes it! He takes the catch on the move and the force of the ball sends him toppling to the ground but he hangs on. A superb effort and Russell is pumped!
the faster ball this time and Gayle is beaten on the pull
that's too short, way too short to be bowling at Gayle, who rocks back, winds up and heaves mightily. The ball disappears into the cheering fans at deep midwicket
it's the googly from Hogg and Gayle waits on the back foot and plays it back to the bowler
and Gayle has hammered him, high and far over the deep square leg boundary. He got down low on one knee and slog swept him with tremendous power. It takes a while for the crowd to return the ball
short ball and Gayle pulls to deep midwicket for a single
short of a length and straight, Kohli nudges off his hips towards square leg
awesome strike! Kohli moves outside leg stump and swings across the line, using his wrists to send the slower ball over the wide long-on boundary
a slower ball dragged a bit short, Gayle spotted it late but adjusted well, pulling along the ground to deep square leg
played through midwicket this time
a high full toss, on the hips, Kohli glances and makes good contact, sending the ball racing to the fine leg boundary, Kohli looks expectantly at the umpire for a no-ball
that's deep into the stands beyond long off! Gayle got under a full ball and lofted through the line, clearing his front foot and hammering it, this chase is alive and well
Yadav might have lost grip on that delivery, he sprayed it so far wide outside off stump
good length outside off and Kohli bottom edges a pull behind square, just the single this time
Kohli plays his wristy, whippy flick but can't beat the fielder at midwicket
fuller ball around off stump, Kohli plays it back to the bowler, Yadav fields in his follow through
shorter length and Kohli swivels on the back foot, lifting his front foot in the air as he pulls to the square leg boundary
a length ball outside off stump. Kohli goes after it, hitting through the line, lofting the ball straight over the bowler, the trajectory is flat but there's enough power to take it all the way
nearly in the blockhole, Kohli digs it out towards midwicket and they chance a quick single
driven hard but the timing is not good, goes straight to mid off
huge appeal for lbw as Kohli moves across his stumps to flick but misses, that hit him flush on the pad, Cummins is unlucky in my opinion
hit off the front foot towards cover, no timing on that shot, connected with the bottom of his bat
good length on off stump, Kohli pushes forward and drives the ball towards mid off
a full ball on the pads, Gayle nudges it fine off his pads, the fielder runs across on the boundary to prevent it from going over, Gayle is too slow between the wickets so they run just the single
another wide down leg side, Gayle tries to glance again, Cummins is bowling a right-hander's line
starts with a wide down leg side, Gayle tried to glance off his hips but the ball was too far away
